world.title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
world.description: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.

world.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
world.description: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

world.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
world.description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

world.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
world.description: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.

world.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
world.description: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

world.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
world.description: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.

world.title: Missing 11-month-old baby found buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
world.description: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.

world.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
world.description: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

world.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
world.description: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

world.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
world.description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

world.title: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
world.description: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.

world.title: Vinícius Jr sends message to Sudan boy who received prosthetic legs after BBC report sparks appeal
world.description: Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again.

world.title: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
world.description: Hundreds of bus and lorry drivers are blocking traffic along major highway routes across the country.

world.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
world.description: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

world.title: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
world.description: The 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by El Salvador's military, which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.

US.title: Greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers are competing in the Youth Olympics
US.description: Senegal's breakdancers have been practicing for their country's historic hosting of the Youth Olympic Games this month. It's the first time Africa is hosting an Olympic event.

US.title: Kennedy relatives join the fight against Trump's arch, alleging harm to JFK's grave

US.title: What's behind democratic socialists' historic victories in the midterms?

US.title: Following big Democratic wins, these swing voters are looking for results
US.description: For the swing voters NPR is regularly checking in with as part of its Swing Shift series, the election results brought mixed emotions, as does the pending Democratic control of Congress.

US.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a prisoner exchange as talks end with no big breakthrough
US.description: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war. U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi led to this decision, marking the biggest humanitarian release since the war began in 2022.

US.title: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
US.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has been spared from the House's impeachment effort, at least for now. And, federal prosecutors arrested three men accused of being Iran-backed operatives.

US.title: An Iran-backed trio is accused of plotting attacks on a U.K. base hosting U.S. jets
US.description: Iran-backed operatives have been charged over nearly 20 attacks, including a plot on a U.K. base housing U.S. troops. Separately, a U.S. soldier is held in the U.K. on Russia spying claims.

US.title: Morning News Brief: Hegseth impeachment, new House GOP leader, UK probes base plot
US.description: Republicans block Hegseth impeachment, Trump ally picked to lead House GOP minority, UK investigates alleged Iran-backed plot.

US.title: U.S. officials look to Europe to learn how to make prison better
US.description: American prison officials are looking to European nations like Germany and Norway for a roadmap on how to design a prison that emphasizes rehabilitation and a successful return to life on the outside.

US.title: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
US.description: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.
